_comment: Row grouping for the weekly IcM on-call summary. Columns are fixed (New/Resolved/Mitigated + a Transferred-Out total); only these rows are configurable. The default groups by a single synthesized 'business category': source 'composite' reads the team leaf + custom fields and maps (team [+ cf]) -> a business name via the rules table below (first match wins; cf omitted = any cf for that team; unmatched -> raw team leaf). Alternatives: source 'column' (an Incidents column like Severity), source 'customField' (raw cf value). Order of dimensions = nesting.
_daytimeNote: On-call roster only counts the Sydney daytime shift (08:00-16:00); the rotation is follow-the-sun (3x8h/day) so without this one person shows as both primary and secondary. Set daytime to null to include all shifts.
_notes: The business-category custom field lives under two ids (45266, 45272) for different teams; both are listed in customFieldIds so a team's cf value is picked up regardless of which id holds it. To reclassify: edit the rules (add/rename business categories, merge teams by mapping to the same name, split a team by cf). No KQL change needed. Raw cf vocabulary seen: Blueprint, Execution Plan, Fulfillment (cf 45266); Other request related, Creating Request on Lionrock Portal, OnDemandQuota Ev2 extension (cf 45272). Most teams (Whitelist&Quota, SubscriptionWhitelisting, CIS-Ev2Bridge, plannedQuotas) set no cf, so they map by team alone.
